scope: All 81 countryCode NO property entries in the current official Norwegian Scandic catalogue, including partner/by-Scandic properties. Not all Norwegian chains. Review coverage is complete for this catalogue snapshot; three charge-unknown properties are withheld, and unresolved billing/registration/tariffs are explicitly listed.
policy: Green: verified free option; Blue: free with required registration; Yellow: paid at hotel AND on hotel receipt; Red: confirmed paid without both billing facts, or difficult access. Unknown charge is withheld, never assumed paid or free. Negative distance placeholders are not walking distances. Zero amounts in a paid source data block mean unpriced, never free.
